From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Helix throughput validation — scheduling readout

Hi Sam / Helix Eng,

Thanks again for sharing the token distribution and SLO targets last week. We want to run a short architecture readout where Redwood's perf team will walk through the proposed load test plan, target throughput scenarios, and the fallback policies we'll exercise during the run. The goal is to align on pass/fail criteria and calendar a single coordinated slot for the live test.

Proposed slots (Pacific time):
- Tue May 26, 9:00–10:30am PT
- Wed May 27, 11:00am–12:30pm PT
- Thu May 28, 2:00–3:30pm PT

Agenda (30–45 minute readout + Q/A + booking the load window):
- 5m quick intros and attendees
- 15m architecture overview + perf knobs (batching, KV cache presets, quantization profile)
- 15m load test plan and expected metrics collection (p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization)
- 10m acceptance criteria and next steps (rollout/fallback)

Can you confirm preferred slots and who from Helix will attend? Also attaching a lightweight runbook and the target matrix you sent so we can annotate. If none of these times work I can propose more options.

Attachments: redwood_loadtest_runbook_v1.pdf, helix_target_matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sam Torres <s.torres@helixsw.com>

Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Helix throughput validation — scheduling readout

Vanessa,

Thanks — all good on the agenda. For attendees we'll have:
- Sam Torres (Eng Lead)
- Priya Malhotra (SRE)
- Josh Nguyen (ML infra)

Quick notes on what we'd like to validate during the readout:
- Sustained 3k tokens/sec across a 60s window on our typical 32-token prompt mix
- P99 latency under 450ms for single-stream low-latency queries (aiming for 200–300ms)
- Behavior when we hit peak burst (10k tokens/sec) and fallback to smaller quantized model

Of the three slots you proposed, Wed May 27 11:00am PT is best for the core engineering team. If you can lock that, we can circulate a calendar invite and include any test harness credentials. Also please note that procurement copied on this thread needs to see the readout summary for approval.

On a practical note — our staging cluster is in us-west2 (GCP). If Redwood needs to route tests through a specific region or reserved pool please flag.

Best,
Sam
Sam Torres
Engineering Lead | Helix Software
